name: Nathan
overview: Nathan is identified in Scripture as one of the sons of David and Bath-sheba, alongside his brothers Shammua, Shobab, and Solomon, as recorded in 2 Samuel 5:14, 1 Chronicles 3:5, and 1 Chronicles 14:4. These passages emphasize Nathan's place within the royal lineage of David, highlighting his role within the family that would carry forward the Davidic covenant. While the provided verses focus on his genealogical position, other biblical texts recognize Nathan as a prophet and key figure in David's reign, underscoring his importance in the history of Israel and the Messianic line.
